data.description: As a free action every 1d4 rounds, the aluum's enslaved souls may emit a keening wail in a 15-ft. cone. Creatures in the cone take 10d6 points of sonic damage and are stunned for 1 round. A DC %1 Will save halves the damage and negates the stun effect. This is a sonic mind-affecting effect.
data.name: Soul Shriek
